methods.description: Identify the base and index,read the power aloud,and recognise the unwritten index1.
Group equal numerical factors and count each group to write its base and index,retaining singly occurring factors.
Write each power as its stated number of equal factors and count requested factors or their total.
Show equal groups explicitly to rewrite a supplied product using the requested composite base; distinguish unequal factor counts from an invalid combined-base claim.
